ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of a spirit animal

plain.li: {PET_nameDef} walked beside me in the dream and spoke, in a voice like wind in the long grass. It said the herds will come back with the rain.
My spirit animal came to me in the dream. {PET_nameDef}. It said nothing for a long time, and then it said my name.
In the dream {PET_nameDef} told me where the water runs under the ground. I woke knowing it, and I don't know how.
[voice:dog] In the dream {PET_nameDef} ran ahead of me and called back in a voice like mine: this way, this way, I know the way.
[voice:cat] {PET_nameDef} sat on my chest in the dream and told me, very patiently, everything I have been doing wrong.
[voice:horse] {PET_nameDef} carried me across a plain of white grass and said, without turning its head, that I was heavier than my worries.
[voice:herd] The whole herd spoke in the dream, all at once, with {PET_nameDef}'s voice. They said they were not afraid of the winter.
[voice:bird] {PET_nameDef} flew over the colony in the dream and named every one of us from up there, as if counting us home.
[voice:thrumbo] {PET_nameDef} lay down by the fire in the dream and told me about the world before people, slowly, for a very long time.
[voice:pokemon] {PET_nameDef} spoke in the dream with a voice too big for it, and told me which way the storm would come.
[temper:loyal] {PET_nameDef} said in the dream: I was here before you woke, and I will be here when you sleep for good.
[temper:mischievous] In the dream {PET_nameDef} laughed at me, properly laughed, and then showed me where it had hidden my good knife.
[afterraid] {PET_nameDef} stood over me in the dream and said the ones who came are gone, and our dead are not angry.
[winter] {PET_nameDef} curled round me in the dream, in the snow, and said the cold is only the land sleeping.
[child] {PET_nameDef} talked to me all night in my dream. It said I'm going to be brave when I'm big.

warm.li: {PET_nameDef} came to me in the dream and said thank you, for every meal and every scratch behind the ears.

gloomy.li: In the dream {PET_nameDef} told me the dead walk with us still, and that it sees them. I was glad, and then I wasn't.

cold.li: {PET_nameDef} spoke to me in the dream, as the old ones say a spirit animal will. I wrote down what it said.
